title: Owner Mosaic Stitch and Rotation Slate
content:
Purpose: lightweight cross-functional owner roster + short-term rotation queue for ephemeral coverage needs (inc. launch days, patch windows, field ops). Not intended as canonical replacement for on-call lists — this is a fast, ad-hoc mosaic for immediate handoffs and short TTL items.

Canonical columns (sheet view):
Item ID | Short description | Primary owner | Backup owner | Owning team | Rotation window (days) | SLO impact score (1-5) | Cover confidence (HI/MED/LOW) | Status | Last action (date) | Next step (owner) | Linked ticket / repo | Notes

Rows:
1 | Canary rollout route-override (EU region) | Priya Singh | Diego Ramos | eng-platform-engineering | 3 | 4 | MED | in_progress | 2029-06-28 | Priya to validate route rules | JIRA-RED-5829 | temporary route override active; monitor error spike for 6h
2 | Short-term embedding cache flush | Diego Ramos | Liam O'Neill | serving-runtime | 1 | 2 | HI | scheduled | 2029-06-30 | Diego to run flush & confirm | GH-873 | pre-emptive flush before partner demo (low risk)
3 | Demo account quota bump (finance signoff pending) | Aisha Carter | Priya Singh | product-product-ops | 7 | 1 | LOW | awaiting | 2029-06-25 | Aisha to follow up with finance | CONFLUENCE-582 | temporary credit applied; remove after demo window
4 | Regional fallback smoke for private deploys (APAC) | Liam O'Neill | SRE oncall | site-reliability-engineering | 5 | 5 | MED | in_progress | 2029-06-29 | Liam to run smoke and escalate | JIRA-RED-5901 | edge-case certificates expired on test nodes
5 | Lightweight cost-drain triage (embeddings surge) | Priya Singh | Finance liaison (Samir) | product-ops | 2 | 3 | LOW | triage | 2029-06-30 | Priya to consolidate top 3 queries | JIRA-RED-5918 | initial spike correlated with analytics job; may be caching gap
6 | One-off A/B routing toggle revert | Diego Ramos | Aisha Carter | platform-engineering | 1 | 3 | LOW | scheduled | 2029-06-30 | Diego to run revert window | GH-885 | revert if latency > 200ms p95
7 | Partner on-call handover note (quick patch) | Aisha Carter | Partner SE (Ying) | solutions-engineering | 4 | 2 | MED | done | 2029-06-27 | N/A | JIRA-PART-123 | handover doc uploaded; partner confirmed receipt
8 | Quick-capture client incident postmortem stub | Liam O'Neill | Priya Singh | site-reliability-engineering | 10 | 1 | LOW | draft | 2029-06-26 | Priya to add metrics snapshot | CONFLUENCE-POST-742 | keep short; link to full page later
9 | Burst capacity reservation check (dedicated pool) | Diego Ramos | Capacity PM (Hannah) | dedicated | 3 | 4 | MED | in_progress | 2029-06-29 | Diego to confirm pool availability | JIRA-RED-5933 | tentative reservation pending contract review
10 | Quick eval: quantization test on staging (small model) | Priya Singh | ML infra (Carter) | applied-ml | 2 | 3 | LOW | scheduled | 2029-06-30 | Priya to run perf + quality delta | GH-899 | run with 8-bit profile; compare logits distribution
11 | Short-run rollback checklist for feature flag X | Aisha Carter | Diego Ramos | product-ops | 1 | 5 | MED | ready | 2029-06-30 | Aisha to coordinate rollback window | JIRA-RED-5940 | checklist: db-migrations, cache-warm, route-disable
12 | One-off security review triage (non-blocking) | Security SME (Mei) | Liam O'Neill | security-and-compliance | 5 | 4 | LOW | in_review | 2029-06-28 | Mei to add remediation owner | CONFLUENCE-Sec-211 | small finding; scheduled patch in next sprint
13 | Temporary analytics pipeline backfill | Analytics (Noah) | Priya Singh | observability | 7 | 2 | MED | blocked | 2029-06-24 | Noah to unblock upstream | JIRA-RED-5892 | blocked on export permissions from partner system
14 | Quick user-impact sample for customer X | Customer Success (Maya) | Solutions SE (Rashid) | customer-success | 2 | 3 | LOW | scheduled | 2029-06-30 | Maya to gather sample set | JIRA-CUST-331 | narrow window coordinated with CS

Summary metrics (ad-hoc):
- Total rows tracked: 14
- Open / actionable: 9
- Blocked / awaiting external: 3
- Average rotation window: ~3.1 days
- High SLO-impact items (>4): 3 (IDs: 1,4,11)

Notes to self / housekeeping:
- This sheet is intentionally permissive about formatting to keep onboarding low friction. If an item will exceed a 10-day TTL, move it to the canonical backlog (product-ops backlog).
- Coverage confidence is subjective; when marking LOW, add a one-line mitigation.
- For any item flagged with SLO impact >=4, add explicit rollback plan + contact numbers in the Notes column.

Unresolved questions / follow-ups:
- Who is most appropriate as a default backup for serving-runtime on short notice? (Diego/Liam rotation seems okay but we should add an on-call alias)
- Confirm whether finance will accept temporary quota increases without PO for demo partners (Aisha to escalate)

Action items (next 48h):
- Priya: run embedding cache flush and post results (due 2029-07-01)
- Diego: confirm dedicated pool reservation status and update JIRA-RED-5933 (due 2029-07-01)
- Liam: finish APAC fallback smoke and post logs to CONFLUENCE-REDWOOD-ops-mosaic-320 (due 2029-06-30)

Quick provenance: created as a rapid stitching artifact to reduce cross-team handoff friction for a set of short-lived operational tasks around the 2029-06-30 partner/demo window. Keep the sheet alive only while items exist; archive to confluence with summary when cleared.

Small formatting legend below sheet:
- Status: scheduled | in_progress | triage | blocked | done | awaiting | draft | ready
- Cover confidence: HI / MED / LOW
- SLO impact: 1 (low) - 5 (critical)

End of tracker.
